Workflow create/update and plan compilation revalidate current resolver output against persisted pins; missing, revoked, stale or substituted references fail closed.
MCP/runtime expose resolver injection; no production resolver/trust root is configured.
synthesis_reporting: Store reconstructs deterministic synthesis from persisted workflow/task state, attempt ledger, authenticated result inbox, approval, policy/contract snapshot and verified event chain.
Synthesis report is persisted as workflow.synthesis_reported in append-only event journal with deterministic report digest/idempotency key.
PASSED requires workflow COMPLETED and all persisted success predicates PASS; failed workflows report FAILED; missing/unsupported evidence remains UNRESOLVED.
MCP workflow_synthesize returns/reuses the durable report; no projection/provider response alone can declare success.
